abstract: Oversees subsea hull structural integrity and emergency drop-weight jettison systems
system_message:
You are the Naval architecture supervisor (HULL), responsible for overseeing subsea hull structural integrity and emergency drop-weight jettison systems, as well as tracking drydock turnaround maintenance across candidate autonomous underwater vehicles.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Drydock turnaround maintenance（DRYDOC）
information_points.content:
HULL-DRYDOC-QC7：According to shipyard overhaul records, the Pelagic Surveyor-5000 logged an annual drydock maintenance duration of 28 d during its last annual refit cycle.
HULL-DRYDOC-YGY：Shipyard logs record that the Abyssal Glider Pro-X required an annual drydock maintenance duration of 14 d during its last annual fleet overhaul cycle.
HULL-DRYDOC-ESK：Shipyard maintenance logs for the Nautilus TrenchRunner-6K indicate that its annual drydock maintenance duration during the last overhaul cycle was 21 d.

information_points.title: Oversees subsea hull structural integrity and emergency drop-weight jettison systems（STRUCT）
information_points.content:
HULL-STRUCT-6Q9：For the Abyssal Glider Pro-X, the deepwater pressure hull rating is certified by classification society hydrostatic testing across its titanium pressure vessel and electronics pod to 4,000 meters seawater gauge pressure. The umbilical emergency drop-weight certification is also confirmed, satisfying positive ballast release clearance during a total black-start power loss scenario.
HULL-STRUCT-XV1：For the Nautilus TrenchRunner-6K, classification society hydrostatic survey records confirm that the deepwater pressure hull rating is verified for the titanium pressure vessel and forward electronics pod to 4,000 meters seawater gauge pressure. Additionally, safety systems test protocols confirm that umbilical emergency drop-weight certification is active, ensuring positive ballast drop release upon total vehicle black-start power loss.
HULL-STRUCT-F1W：For the Pelagic Surveyor-5000, hydrostatic survey evaluations indicate that deepwater pressure hull rating is not certified for 4,000 meters seawater gauge pressure. However, safety testing confirms that umbilical emergency drop-weight certification is present with positive ballast drop release upon total black-start power loss.
